versions.subject: Add posh_ps_susp_set_alias
versions.detection:
selection_cmdlet:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'Set-Alias '
        - 'New-Alias '
selection_name:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - '-Name '
        - '-Nam '
        - '-Na '
        - '-N '
selection_value:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - '-Value '
        - '-Valu '
        - '-Val '
        - '-Va '
        - '-V '
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText IN ("*Set-Alias *", "*New-Alias *") ScriptBlockText IN ("*-Name *", "*-Nam *", "*-Na *", "*-N *") ScriptBlockText IN ("*-Value *", "*-Valu *", "*-Val *", "*-Va *", "*-V *")
